headline: Philippine Banks Set to Adopt Revised Government Bond Pricing Standards
summary: The Bankers Association of the Philippines confirmed member banks are prepared to adopt government-mandated bond pricing standards by end-November. Meanwhile, domestic sovereign bond yields ended mixed following domestic growth data.
why: Standardized bond valuation models aim to improve pricing transparency and trading liquidity for Philippine government debt securities.

impacts.name: Philippines 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Adopting revised bond pricing standards changes valuation metrics across Philippine government debt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market adaptation to new government bond pricing standards causes mixed yield movements across short- and long-term Philippine paper.
